content.value: . A gas turbine power plant operating on an ideal Brayton cycle has a pressure ratio of 8. The gas temperature is 300 Kat the compressor inlet and 1300 Kat the turbine inlet. Utilizing the air-standard assumptions, determine (i) the gas temperature at the exit of the compressor and the turbine, (ii) the thermal efficiency.
